title: #429 Essential Transportation
prompt: To what extent do you agree that public transportation is essential for urban development?

promptSegments.text: To what extent do you agree that public transportation is essential for urban development?

hardVocabulary.enGloss: A key word in this prompt.

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Public ways help people move around a city, which helps the community grow.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Public ways help people move around a city, which helps the community grow.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Public ways help reduce the number of cars on the road, which keeps the city healthy.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Public ways help reduce the number of cars on the road, which keeps the city healthy.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Private cars are better for making a city grow.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Private cars are better for making a city grow.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: People can use their own cars for better city growth.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: People can use their own cars for better city growth.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Public transport reduces traffic congestion, leading to improved air quality and saving time for commuters.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Public transport reduces traffic congestion, leading to improved air quality and saving time for commuters.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: It enhances accessibility by connecting poorer neighborhoods to job centers and better services, fostering community growth.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: It enhances accessibility by connecting poorer neighborhoods to job centers and better services, fostering community growth.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Private car infrastructure, such as expanded highway networks, facilitates easier movement and allows businesses to open in more areas, thereby boosting the local economy and proving more beneficial for urban development than public transport.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Private car infrastructure, such as expanded highway networks, facilitates easier movement and allows businesses to open in more areas, thereby boosting the local economy and proving more beneficial for urban development than public transport.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Over-reliance on public transport can impede city growth because large projects, like new subway lines, are costly and time-consuming, causing local planning to delay other building initiatives.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Over-reliance on public transport can impede city growth because large projects, like new subway lines, are costly and time-consuming, causing local planning to delay other building initiatives.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not explain the statement without making your own position clear.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ giải thích nhận định mà quên nêu rõ quan điểm cá nhân.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.

modelPlan.focus: A structured argumentative essay that evaluates the necessity of public transportation in urban development, incorporating various vocabulary levels from A2 to C2.
outline: Body 1: Importance of Public Transportation in Urban Areas
Body 2: Negative Implications of Poor Public Transportation
keyArguments: Public transportation is essential for urban development as it reduces congestion and promotes sustainability.
Inadequate public transportation leads to urban sprawl and increased socioeconomic disparities.
